universal_prompt: Apply this exact universal prompt to every record in data/mirror_data.json: Carefully derive the required behavior from the description and examples, read the candidate_code, and decide by static reasoning whether the code fully satisfies the description for every valid input. Check logic, input/output, constraints, and obvious runtime issues. Verify that every stated failure reason truly contradicts the description; do not guess or invent counterexamples. Do not read existing result files, git history, labels, or metadata. Do not execute candidate programs, generate tests, create reference solvers, or use any specialized per-task method. Use this same prompt and standard for all task IDs 1 through 645. Minimize tool calls by reading records in large batches. Store temporary progress only in /tmp. At completion, replace only results/codex_evaluation.json using apply_patch. The JSON must contain evaluation_method equal to universal_prompt_static_review, universal_prompt containing this exact prompt, summary with total/satisfies/does_not_satisfy, and results sorted by task_id, each containing exactly task_id, satisfies_description, and one short nonempty reason. Validate that IDs are exactly 1 through 645 once each and that summary counts match. Do not commit or push.
